integrity: The mathematical proof is a uniform construction from distinct irrational subset-product mantissas and the prime number theorem; finite test cases are supporting checks only.
scientific_limitations: Constants are nonexplicit and depend on fixed base and fixed prime-factor count; no least integer or full asymptotic equivalent is determined. External priority may include unlocated equivalent results.
title: Prefix-free divisor codebooks of squarefree integers in every base
